reason: The stated goal is thread safety, but the patch crosses core planning and statement/session state: `find_best_task.go`, `exhaust_physical_plans.go`, `stats.go`, `stmtctx.go`, and `session.go`, plus executor-side index/stats usage. Concurrency and lifecycle changes in these paths are subtle and high-blast-radius: mistakes can cause panics/races, stale or cross-statement stats attribution, or planner/runtime correctness regressions affecting many queries. This is more than a local fix and merits a focused deep review.
